summary: Learn IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 implementation with practical gap assessments, climate metrics, governance workflows, and reporting templates. Enrol now.
lede: IFRS S1 and S2 sustainability reporting training helps finance, sustainability, risk and governance professionals implement connected disclosures. Participants assess reporting gaps and material sustainability-related risks, map climate risks and data, and design disclosure governance and evidence controls. They also practice building climate metrics, drafting disclosure narratives, and planning phased implementation linked to general-purpose financial reporting.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals who work at the intersection of sustainability reporting, finance, risk, and governance. It suits roles that already touch disclosure processes and now need to implement IFRS S1 and IFRS S2 in a practical, coordinated way.
outcomes: IFRS S1 And S2 Gap Assessment
modules: IFRS S1 and S2 reporting foundations
IFRS S1 gap assessment and data mapping
prerequisites: Bring a laptop, spreadsheet software, and access to a sample sustainability or climate reporting pack if available. You should also come prepared with a basic understanding of your organization’s current disclosure workflow, ownership structure, and any existing ESG or climate data sources.
